title: South African national accounts × physical resource account bridge
hypothesis: An NRVCA evidence and reconciliation contract can reproduce selected source-published national-account values and selected physical account identities while exposing time/geography/unit incompatibilities and source coverage that a disconnected indicator dashboard hides.
null_hypothesis: The contract adds no reproducibility or evidence-quality advantage over a direct source-table transcription and independent source-native calculation; or its added mapping introduces unreconciled residuals or unsupported joins.

scope.period_scope: Initial source discovery includes GDP Q2 2026, experimental PEFA 2022, and selected catchment water accounts for hydrological years 2015/16–2020/21; aligned periods are not yet available.
scope.unit_of_analysis: source table × published value/identity × exact source vintage
out_of_scope: National water-security estimates extrapolated from three selected catchments.
A universal prosperity score or monetary monetization of all nonmarket activity.
Forecasting benchmarks before source vintages and definitions are reconciled.

arms.method: Direct reproduction of source-published official GDP totals from the exact pinned Stats SA release
arms.description: Use the source-published GDP series and tables as the incumbent target; preserve published price basis and release vintage.
arms.resource_budget_policy: Same source artifacts and declared transformations; no later vintages or hidden manual corrections.

arms.description: Recompute selected PEFA and water-account identities from source-native tables using their documented units, periods and definitions.
arms.resource_budget_policy: Same exact source bytes and published metadata; independent calculation code; no NRVCA-only helper.

arms.method: NRVCA source-bound account and capability bridge
arms.description: Represent source-published values, account identities, physical units, time basis, evidence status, coverage and noncomparabilities in the versioned NRVCA contract.
arms.resource_budget_policy: Same source bytes and permitted data; report integration/validation cost separately from source-native baseline costs.

metrics.definition: Count of preregistered selected source-published numeric values reconstructed within the source's documented rounding tolerance divided by the number of selected values.
metrics.acceptance_rule: All selected values reproduce within documented rounding tolerance; every deviation remains listed with a classified reason.

metrics.definition: Number of preregistered account identities that close within declared source precision divided by identities attempted.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Every identity included as qualified must close. No unexplained residual is silently suppressed.

metrics.definition: Share of report references resolving to an exact pinned source artifact and source locator.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Every source-dependent claim must resolve to an admitted source manifest entry and locator.

metrics.definition: Number of nonzero residuals with no documented accounting, rounding, coverage or semantic disposition.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Must be zero for a qualified result; otherwise return unqualified with all residuals preserved.

metrics.definition: Number of joins across incompatible periods, units, geographies or statistical statuses without an explicit reviewed mapping.
metrics.acceptance_rule: Must be zero; any unsupported mapping is rejected rather than coerced.

metrics.definition: Whether every source-derived summary reports applicable geographic/temporal coverage, missingness and official-versus-experimental status.
metrics.acceptance_rule: All required source summaries carry coverage, missingness and statistical status.

comparison_protocol.sampling_or_split: Accounting reproduction uses a frozen, preregistered census of source tables and identities; a later forecast trial must use vintage-aware rolling-origin holdouts and be preregistered separately.
comparison_protocol.independent_oracle: Direct source-table reproduction plus separately implemented arithmetic for selected account identities; do not reuse the candidate's calculation helper as the sole oracle.
comparison_protocol.uncertainty_method: For published table reproduction, use the source's declared rounding/revision precision. For estimated indicators, retain source intervals and model uncertainty; do not invent confidence intervals from scenario counts.
comparison_protocol.subgroup_policy: Report coverage by source, table, geography, period, unit, and official/experimental status. No unreported country-wide inference from the selected catchments.
comparison_protocol.multiple_comparison_policy: Freeze selected tables, identities and primary metrics before calculations; preserve all failed, missing and discordant cases.

guardrails: No source bytes enter reproducibility runs before use-rights review.
GDP source vintage and price basis remain explicit; later revisions create a new run.
Experimental PEFA and sub-national water accounts never become official statistics by aggregation.
Calendar-quarter GDP and hydrological-year water values are not joined without an explicitly reviewed method.
Unknown water service or quality is not zero, safe, adequate or available.
No national estimate is inferred from selected catchments without a separately justified sampling/aggregation design.
A modelled estimate never becomes an observed measurement by serialization, ledger attestation or visualization.
claim_ceiling: This is a design-only benchmark preregistration, not an executed evaluation.
No source file has been pinned or licensed by this record.
No NRVCA performance advantage, official-standard conformity, national output estimate or causal effect is established.
The result, if later completed, applies only to the pinned values, identities, periods, units, and sources.
